header.tagline: Basketball Intelligence For Matchups, History And Live Prediction Ops

auth.title: Sign in with cleaner access and real workspace context.
auth.subtitle: Authentication runs against the live backend, so sessions, prediction history and admin actions persist in the real app state.
auth.clickToFill: Click any card to fill the form instantly.
auth.userNote: History, saved runs and scouting views
auth.signInHint: Use email or a short demo alias like admin, operator or user.
auth.registerHint: Registration creates a real user in the backend and starts a live session immediately.
auth.demoHint: Demo aliases work here too: enter admin, operator or user instead of the full email.
auth.newAccountHint: New accounts are created with the standard user role and can start saving predictions immediately.
auth.invalidCredentials: Invalid credentials. Try one of the demo accounts below.

home.title: Cleaner match intelligence, less landing-page noise.
home.subtitle: The home screen now works more like a sports hub: key metrics first, current matchup second, and the rest of the information split into clearer sections instead of one long decorative feed.
home.nextFixture: The next loaded fixture will appear here.
home.predictionEngineDesc: Historical sample size is stable and the prediction endpoint is responding through the live backend.
home.scheduleWindowDesc: {upcoming} upcoming games and {recent} finished games are available for browsing.
home.navigationCleanupDesc: Instead of stacking everything vertically, the home page now separates schedule, team and prediction views into tabs.
home.noPredictions: You have not saved any prediction runs yet. Start with a matchup and the result will appear here and in history.
home.signInPrompt: Sign in to save predictions, revisit results and compare model outputs over time.

teams.title: Standings and team identity in one tighter board.
teams.subtitle: Compare teams quickly in standings view, then switch to cards when you want more visual detail.

matches.title: Schedule and results in one tighter slate view.
matches.subtitle: Scan the slate, open a game for context, or jump into prediction workflows without fighting the layout.
matches.allDesc: Showing the full slate with finished and scheduled matchups together.
matches.upcomingDesc: Showing only upcoming games that are ready for previews and prediction flows.
matches.finalsDesc: Showing final scores for quick review and comparison.
matches.noMatches: No games match the current filter.

players.title: Player profiles with season switcher
players.subtitle: Click any card to open the full profile where you can switch between seasons.
players.clickPrompt: Click any card to open profile with season switcher.

analytics.title: One analytics workspace, split into clearer operating views.
analytics.subtitle: Model quality, league context and schedule behavior now live in separate sections so the page reads more like an internal console and less like a wall of widgets.
analytics.modelDesc: Model view keeps the focus on health, factor mix and database coverage.
analytics.leagueDesc: League view highlights contenders, offensive output and comparative team context.
analytics.scheduleDesc: Schedule view surfaces game load and recently tracked fixtures.

prediction.buildMatchup: Build a matchup and let the model work from real team context.
prediction.historicalContext: Historical rows, recent form, roster quality and matchup context now flow together through the live prediction engine.
prediction.pickBoth: Pick both teams before starting the model.
prediction.savedToAccount: Prediction is saved to your account and scored by the hybrid model immediately.
prediction.signInRequired: Sign in to run private predictions.
prediction.signInDesc: Predictions are stored against real user accounts, so you need an authenticated session before the model can save and return a result.

admin.title: Admin tools grouped into a cleaner control room.
admin.subtitle: Users, audits and backups stay in separate operational views so moderation and maintenance feel tighter and easier to scan.

notfound.title: This page is off the board.
notfound.subtitle: The route you requested is not available in the current build.

history.signInRequired: Your history becomes available after sign-in.
history.signInDesc: Prediction history is tied to authenticated accounts and stored in the connected database.
history.title: Your prediction history.
history.subtitle: Every run is tied to your account and available for quick review inside the app.
